item.text:
Implemented the reported fixes and features in place.

- Monthly recurring transactions now use the last valid day of shorter months.
- CSV parsing preserves quoted fields that contain line breaks.
- Delete uses the transaction’s original list index after filtering or sorting.
- Budget spending counts expenses only, so refunds do not increase spending.
- Balance is formatted to two decimal places.
- Reloading a budget or report route keeps that view open.
- Transactions can be edited and undone; category renaming updates matching transactions and budgets, with transaction changes undoable.
- The report includes a signed month-over-month change and categories present only in the previous month.

I did not run tests.
